issues.detail: hideCommands removes corepack only from PATH; Node 22 still bundles corepack's JS under the global node_modules. A determined run could invoke it by path, and if the image's pnpm was provisioned through Corepack, `corepack prepare pnpm@10 --activate` might resolve from the local cache offline. The record's required verification also demands an environment with no pnpm preinstalled, so even this path would not fully satisfy it; the risk of the premise collapsing is small.
issues.fix: In documenter-64/spec.json selfChecks, add {"cmd": "node \"$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(which node))))/lib/node_modules/corepack/dist/corepack.js\" prepare pnpm@10 --activate", "expect": "fail", "expectOutput": "ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|fetch|No such file|Cannot find module", "why": "Corepack cannot provision pnpm 10 even when invoked by path"}. If this unexpectedly passes, also add the bundled corepack path to runtime.unreadable.
